notes: Spirantised intervocalically, within a morpheme and across a morpheme boundary: /teba/ [teβa] 'a, one' (pp. 171-172).
Occasionally a spirant intervocalically within a morpheme, much less consistently than /b/; not across a morpheme boundary (p. 172).
A 2-3 tap alveolar trill; geminate r is a lengthened (5-6 tap?) trill (p. 171, n. 11).

High vocoids tend to be non-syllabic word-initially before a vowel, word-finally after a vowel, intervocalically and postvocalically before a consonant (/iema/ [yema] 'knife'), except in words of two vocoids whose second vowel is non-high (/ia/ [iya]) (p. 172). Interpreted as vowels, since semivocalisation precedes stress (p. 173).

environment: _#, optionally, after voiceless obstruents and nasals
notes: Final vowels are optionally devoiced; when not devoiced they are sometimes followed by slight glottal closure (p. 172).
